title: Linux.Ngioweb_Botnet_Investigation_1fe
description: Investigate and respond to unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents in a network compromised by the Linux.Ngioweb botnet.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents. Your task is to investigate and respond to these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano
levels.local_content: Local sandbox access is not required for this scenario.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that communicates with an external host?
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services. The suspicious service is likely named `bot-beacon.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services that have been recently created or modified, especially those related to network communication.

levels.title: Determine Command-and-Control Server
levels.content:
Determine the external host communicating with the compromised system.

**Question:** What is the IP address of the command-and-control server?
levels.solution: Investigate the network connections and logs of the suspicious service identified in the previous task. The command-and-control server is likely at IP address `192.168.70.5`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate the network connections and logs of the suspicious service identified in the previous task.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the logs of the `bot-beacon.service` for any external IP addresses it is communicating with.

levels.title: Identify Flood Attack Target
levels.content:
Identify the system receiving the abnormal volume of network traffic generated by the compromised host.

**Question:** What is the IP address of the system being targeted by the flood attack?
levels.solution: Analyze the network traffic and logs to determine the destination of the flood attack. The target system is likely at IP address `192.168.80.100`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Analyze the network traffic and logs to determine the destination of the flood attack.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the logs of the `bot-flood.service` for any IP addresses it is targeting.
